args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export skipping the first week after creation
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Investigate and fix the issue where a weekly scheduled export created early in the day does not send the first export email on the day it is created. The problem appears to be related to the calculation of the next run date for weekly cadence, which currently sets the next run to 7 days after the last export regardless of the creation time. Adjust the scheduling logic to correctly handle the first week after a schedule is created so that the export is sent as expected on the first scheduled day.
